# Synthetic portfolio snapshot fixtures

Generated by `scripts/generate-portfolio-fixtures.mjs`. All holdings, prices,
and costs are fictional — these reproduce the *shape* of broker and
fund-house holdings exports, not real positions. No real export was
available (see `docs/19_OPEN_DECISIONS.md`, D-005), so the column layouts are
inferred from common formats and must be re-validated against the user's
actual Zerodha/Groww exports.

| File | Scenario |
|---|---|
| `equity-v1-base.csv` | Baseline equity + ETF holdings with LTP and average cost |
| `equity-v2-corrected.csv` | Same date, TCS quantity corrected 20 → 25 — a revision, original retained |
| `equity-v3-later-date.csv` | Later date, INFY grown 50 → 75 — a new observation, reported not recorded as a trade |
| `equity-v4-malformed.csv` | Non-numeric quantity, negative holding, blank row, unparseable price |
| `equity-v5-duplicate.csv` | Same instrument listed twice — both lots flagged, neither summed nor dropped |
| `equity-v6-quoted.csv` | Quoted fields with embedded commas and escaped quotes |
| `equity-v7-unusable-layout.csv` | No recognizable quantity column — import writes nothing |
| `mutualfund-v1-base.csv` | MF units and NAV with an invested total instead of average cost |
| `equity-v9-xlsx-export.xlsx` | The same equity holdings as XLSX rather than CSV |
| `mutualfund-v2-real-layout.xlsx` | The real MF-statement layout observed in owner UAT: a Personal Details block and a HOLDING SUMMARY block precede the actual holdings header — no real name/PAN/mobile number, all fictional (D-005) |

Regenerate with:

```bash
node scripts/generate-portfolio-fixtures.mjs
```
